generationRequest.prompt: Use case: edit reference background into ONE isolated transparent FAR ORGAN PARALLAX LAYER for a 2D side-scrolling underwater game inside a dead whale. Preserve reference matte painted gouache style and organ identity. Output landscape16:9 canvas, keep original 1672x941 aspect and composition anchors. This layer contains only 1 or 2 broad perimeter anatomical contours as a single layer, with a large completely transparent center and lower center for gameplay. REMOVE ALL blue water, water rays, bubbles, specks, haze, background wash, floor platforms, near framing, creatures and all props. All empty areas must have genuine zero-alpha transparency, no blue rectangle, no checker pattern. Keep far anatomy muted cool low contrast with soft internal shading but a clean external alpha edge. No bright top ledges that read as gameplay terrain, no cropped gameplay modules. Depict only the following far organ forms: Broad folded pleura and collapsed lung contours clustered at upper-right and far-left edges, no central heart object, no luminous tissue, no trachea platform, no ribs. Thin organ web may connect edge folds but not cross the transparent middle. Dull cool blue-purple lung surface. At least central60% and bottom40% empty transparent. Do not retain water or any volume fog.
